sanskrit:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः।।
caption:
The Doer in Passion (Rajasic Karta). ‘rāgī karma-phala-prepsur’ (The worker who is attached to work and the fruits of work). ‘lubdho hiṁsātmako ‘śuciḥ’ (Who is greedy, violent, and impure). ‘harṣa-śokānvitaḥ kartā’ (And moved by joy and sorrow). ‘rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ’. He is ‘Lubdha’ (greedy). If he doesn’t get the bonus, he gets depressed (‘Shoka’). If he gets it, he gets manic (‘Harsha’). He is an emotional rollercoaster because his self-worth is tied to the result.
